set.body:
Outcome
Provide an optional command composition that works across main and floating windows.

Owned scope
meridian-workbench command composition; sampler command registry/fixture

Prerequisites
C1, C3

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Command registry separates stable IDs, visible labels, availability and execution; UI uses caller-provided actions rather than owning application architecture.
- [ ] Open shortcut honors platform conventions and content-owned key handling; typing filters, Up/Down select, Enter executes exactly once, Escape dismisses and restores prior valid focus.
- [ ] Empty/no-results/disabled commands and clearing search have visible and accessible feedback; focus remains within the open composition.
- [ ] Command invocation from a float acts on its documented context; closing that owner safely closes/reparents the overlay under an explicit tested policy.
- [ ] All four variants and 200% text scaling remain usable; accessible names/results state and reduced-motion behavior are verified.

Required evidence
Keyboard event and action-count tests, no-results/disabled state captures, owner disposal and focus-return probes.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code C5. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.
set.title: [C5] Implement command search with native keyboard and focus semantics
